bootstrap: 2000 draws; a fresh numpy default_rng(0) per cell; idx = rng.choice(N, size=N, replace=True) over the sorted unique speaker ids; 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles; paired = the same idx for both quantities; draws with one class are skipped (none were)
auc: tie-averaged rank formula (scipy rankdata); the verifier recomputes with sklearn.metrics.roc_auc_score
independence: all twin code written for this run (scripts/twin_*.py, twin_mac_perclip.py); none of the PART 16 scripts were imported or copied. The verifier (scripts/verify_twins.py) is separate code with a different AUC routine; it also re-reads every original from summary_all.csv

methods.POD3 3b direction (cosines, by-arm probe: Linux pod refit from q3o_pitt_states.npz ans[:, -1, :] (float64) and the thinker lm_head fetched from the HF hub. Direction = unit(W[YES]^T wy - W[NO]^T wn), wy / wn = mean softmax mass of each id over the cell's clips, ids YES 7414 9454 9693 9834 14004, NO 902 2152 2308 2753 8996. Probe: GroupKFold(5) by speaker, StandardScaler on the training fold, LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000, class_weight=balanced); probe direction = unit(mean fold coef / scale). Without-d as shipped: fold coef minus its d component, held-out projection standardised with the TRAINING fold. Arms from the clip-name prefix (146 conflict / 322 agreement)
methods.POD3 best stage: per stage: 5 repeats of GroupKFold(5) on speaker ids permuted with default_rng(repeat), StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000, class_weight=balanced), OOF AUC per repeat, stage value = mean of the 5; best = argmax; CI = bootstrap of the mean over repeats
methods.M5 (12 rows): the 9 AUC rows recomputed from the per-clip columns of M5_readout_direction_q2a.csv; the 3 random-floor rows by a Mac refit of the probe direction (sklearn 1.7.2, the M5 environment) and 2000 unit normals from a fresh default_rng(0). A Mac refit of the whole M5 pipeline also reproduces every AUC row
methods.M3: speaker AUC on mean p_yes per speaker, paired clip minus speaker bootstrap
methods.M7: Pitt: mean of the 5 per-repeat AUCs of the part10 nested OOF minus the zero-shot AUC; rep5 = AUC of the mean probability
methods.M9 FILES / SWEEPMIN: reopened all 608 inventory files (old G-Drive prefix remapped), re-read each header, counted mass-bearing files (307; 0 missing; 0 disagree with the stored flag); minimum over mass-bearing files of the median mass

findings: Every one of the 39 audit values (25 with no twin, 14 flagged verified with a disagreeing twin) now has a saved twin that agrees at 4 dp, and every interval that exists agrees at 4 dp. 10 of the 39 (MEDAIC 8, POD2 L5 and L6) are log twins, not recomputes.

Cause of the old disagreements. scikit-learn GroupKFold assigns different folds in 1.7.2 (Mac) and 1.9.1 (pods) for the same speaker groups (fold index md5s differ; files mac/q3o_folds_mac.txt, pull/lo-p16twins-1/out/q3o_folds_pod.txt, m5_folds_pod.txt). On identical folds the logistic fits agree (|coef| 2.207710 on both). So the Mac partF refit of POD3 3b (0.7864 vs 0.8307) and the Mac verifier's by-arm 0.5520 / 0.9314 were fold-assignment artefacts: the Linux pod refit gives 0.8307, 0.6145 and 0.9349 exactly.

The reverse holds for M5, which ran on the Mac: the Mac refit reproduces every M5 row, while a Linux sklearn 1.9.1 refit gives probe 0.8044 (not 0.8223), cos 0.0134 (not 0.0145), floor 0.0123 [0.0005, 0.0341]. M5 numbers are tied to sklearn 1.7.2 folds. The M5 verifier disagreed on the 12 rows because it used a different estimator (held-out-fold standardisation, and its own floor), not because the shipped numbers are wrong.

PC-GITA per-stage refits depend on the OpenBLAS kernel at the 1e-4 level: on an AVX512 kernel (SkylakeX, AMD EPYC 9965) all 32 encoder stages x 5 repeats match POD3 exactly; with AVX2 kernels (Haswell, Zen, and the pods 5 to 7 host) 36 of 160 per-repeat cells differ by up to 0.0004, and llm / ans means by up to 0.0002 (llm best stage 0.8961 instead of 0.8960). The table uses the AVX512 runs; best stages never change. Pitt matches on every kernel tried.
Stale caveats that remain: MEDAIC 0.6853 / 0.5930 / 0.7542 / 0.5293 cannot be refit (no states), and they are superseded by PART 17 T7b anyway. POD2 wall-clock and GPU memory are run records only.
